messages:
maria-cs: Crescent seeing intermittent 401s and short 429 bursts during SDK startup after they rolled a new edge/WAF rule. Ticket C-421.
liam-eng: Is it one host or many? Can you paste a sanitized request sample?
maria-cs: Single host. Sample:
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}
They see ~1/10 401s and bursty 429s.
zara-ps: Likely causes: header dropped by proxy/WAF or very short token TTL causing synchronized refresh. TTL?
maria-cs: TTL 15s, lots of pre-warmed serverless workers.
sam-sre: Short TTL + concurrency = refresh stampede. Also proxies sometimes strip Authorization. Ask them to add X-Debug-Id and run:
`curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Debug-Id:probe" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"probe"}'`
maria-cs: They ran it. Logs show occasional auth missing and a few 429s. They temporarily disabled the suspect WAF group and retried: 10/10 200s and 429s reduced after adding jitter to refresh.
liam-eng: If nginx in chain, ensure `proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;`. Recommend raising TTL to ~60s and add jitter while onboarding.
zara-ps: I'll prepare a short checklist with nginx/envoy snippets and token guidance we can share with customers.
maria-cs: Updating ticket with mitigations and next steps. Thanks all :thumbsup:
